headline: Tyreek Hill: Still rehabbing, no signing imminent
description:
Hill's (knee) agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Wednesday that he remains in contact with multiple teams, but "nothing is imminent" with regard to his client potentially finalizing a deal, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. "He's continuing his rehab with the goal of being on a team in the immediate future," Rosenhaus told Schefter.
